Service class: production
The first rule that matches an obligation decides it. Exceptions: a due check that is unresolved blocks from LAYOUT on, but before LAYOUT only a known failure blocks and any other unresolved check warns. A check not assessed is informational at every gate: it blocks nothing and is no pass. A planned physical check may stay planned until the release. The release skips an out-of-scope rule.
  obligation.requirements [required]: Approved requirements and the evidence policy, at every level: a project may demand more (blocks once due, with the exceptions above; blocks at release until resolved)
  obligation.make [required]: Make checks (intent, CAD, route, process, purchase, optical route, export) at the CAD, geometry and process levels (blocks once due, with the exceptions above; blocks at release until resolved)
  obligation.make_evidence [required]: Make checks at the simulation and physical levels (blocks once due, with the exceptions above; blocks at release until resolved)
  obligation.fit [required]: Fit checks: interfaces, features, assembly and motion play (blocks once due, with the exceptions above; blocks at release until resolved)
  obligation.function [required]: Function checks: engineering, function, contact, motion and optical (blocks once due, with the exceptions above; blocks at release until resolved)
  obligation.other [required]: Every other check family, and any check at a level outside the schema (blocks once due, with the exceptions above; blocks at release until resolved)
  exception: optical.route at cad_valid, geometrically_manufacturable, process_planned is decided by obligation.make [required], not obligation.function [required]
  exception: optical.route at simulation_supported, physically_validated is decided by obligation.make_evidence [required], not obligation.function [required]
  exception: motion.play at every schema level is decided by obligation.fit [required], not obligation.function [required]
